description:
1. Packing Technical Documentation & Standardization
• Consolidate product drawings, component lists, BOM, customer requirements and packing specifications for each SKU.
• Create and maintain approved Packing Specifications, visual Work Instructions and packing standards.
• Control document revisions and ensure correct technical packages are available before production.
2. Packing Layout & Component Identification
• Design carton layouts specifying exact position, orientation, layer and quantity of wooden parts and hardware.
• Identify similar-looking, left/right and dimensionally close components; establish part codes, visual references and verification points.
• Define packing sequence and mistake-proofing methods to prevent missing, duplicated, incorrect or mixed parts.
• Validate carton utilization, product protection, weight distribution and safe handling through packing trials.
3. Packing Materials & BOM Control
• Define carton, foam, EPE, PE bag, separator, corner protector, strap, label and accessory-bag specifications.
• Prepare packing material BOM with dimensions, quantities and consumption standards by SKU.
• Investigate BOM-versus-actual discrepancies and optimize material usage, carton CBM and packing cost.
4. Packing Process Development & Production Support
• Establish standard packing methods, workstation setup, material presentation and in-process checks.
• Support NPI trial packing, approval and operator training before mass production.
• Coordinate with Production, Engineering, QC, PMC, Warehouse and Purchasing to resolve packing issues.
5. Packing Quality & Continuous Improvement
• Define pre-sealing quantity and component checks with QC; investigate wrong-part, missing-part and damage defects.
• Implement root-cause corrective actions, Poka-Yoke and process improvements to increase packing accuracy and efficiency.
6. Reporting & Deliverables
• Maintain SKU Packing Technical Packages: layout, packing BOM, specification, WI, trial approval and revision history.
• Report documentation readiness, packing defects, material savings and process improvement results.
7. Complete other tasks assigned by superiors.

requirements_text:
Qualifications
Minimum Academic Requirement Bachelor’s degree or college diploma in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Wood Technology or related field.
Professional Requirement: Minimum 2–3 years in Packing Engineering, Process Engineering or furniture manufacturing; RTA furniture experience preferred.
Age Requirement: Qualification Certificate
Relevant Manufacturing Experience (preferred):
Wooden furniture / Ready-to-Assemble (RTA) furniture / Flat-pack products.
Experience preparing packing layouts, packing BOM, visual work instructions and trial packing.
Familiarity with multi-component products and hardware kits is an advantage.
Knowledge, Skill Requirement:
Ability to read product drawings, component lists, BOM and packing specifications.
Knowledge of cartons, protective materials, packing methods and component identification.
Ability to create 2D/3D layouts using AutoCAD, SketchUp or equivalent software.
Knowledge of Poka-Yoke, 5S, root-cause analysis and process standardization.
Proficient in Excel, Word and technical documentation; ERP familiarity preferred.
Personal Quality Requirement:
High attention to detail, accuracy and strong ownership of technical documentation.
Practical problem-solving skills and a hands-on production-floor approach.
Effective cross-functional communication, organization and continuous improvement mindset.
